title: AIMUG welcome and announcements
summary: Colin McNamara introduces the AI Middleware User Group, its community rules, and the night's speakers.
learn: The group presents on the bleeding edge of technology, specifically things that happened in the last 60 to 90 days in AI.
The community protects the space for sharing new ideas by being cool to each other, recognizing that sharing is vulnerable.
The meetup is independent and supported by members, ensuring no sales pitches are made during the events.
The group meets in person in Austin and online, with office hours available for sharing projects and solving technical problems.
